title: MPR-lite complete-terminal-tree spatial evaluation
locked_discharge_forbidden: 2019-2022 discharge file must not be opened

models.FOLD_GLOBAL_HBV: eight global raw HBV parameters refitted without the target tree
models.FOLD_MPR_LITE: the same eight intercepts plus exactly one registered static-attribute slope per parameter

mpr_attribute_edges.fc_mm: log full-profile SoilGrids available water capacity

fold_refit_contract: delete every discharge observation in the target terminal tree
refit the eight-parameter global HBV from the fixed physical prior
recompute attribute mean and standard deviation excluding all Reaches in the target tree
fit all eight MPR slopes using only remaining-tree discharge
re-evaluate no-refit R0 versus R1 routing using only remaining-tree discharge
predict the deleted tree with static attributes, forcing, topology and geometry only
objective: terminal-tree equal, then station equal ln(1+Q) MSE + 0.1 volume loss + 0.002 Gaussian raw prior
selection: MPR advances if all spatial noninferiority gates pass and fewer than two folds are raw-boundary-confounded; otherwise fold-global advances to the identifiability audit
routing: R0 is the registered parent. In every fold, R1 is tested without land refit and selected only if training-only station and tree paired CI95 upper bounds are both <0 and monthly absolute PBIAS does not worsen by >1 percentage point.
forbidden: coordinates or graph eigenvectors controlling land parameters
target-tree discharge, hydrograph separation, or Q-derived signature in fitting or selection
claim_boundary: The experiment tests spatial transfer of total flow and model response components. It does not observe groundwater, new/old water or water age.
